entities.name: users
entities.description: User accounts with verified email, display name, Google identity, avatar, onboarding and account status.

entities.name: user_platform_roles
entities.description: Optional Platform Admin grant for a user; no row means an ordinary platform user.

entities.name: auth_sessions
entities.description: User sign-in sessions with token digest, absolute and idle expiry, and revocation time.

entities.name: email_otps
entities.description: One-time sign-in code and link digests with expiry, retry, lockout and send-rate counters.

entities.name: google_connection_grants
entities.description: Temporary user and project OAuth grants used to create Google data connections before expiry.

entities.name: projects
entities.description: Project workspaces with owner, domain, objective, tags, progress status and archive timestamp.

entities.name: project_memberships
entities.description: Project memberships and invitations with user, project role, status, inviter and expiry.

entities.name: project_settings
entities.description: Optional versioned settings record of a project, including budget and notification sections.

entities.name: project_files
entities.description: Documents attached to a project, with filename, media type, storage key, size and hash.

entities.name: project_integrations
entities.description: Project Slack, Teams or Discord webhook configuration with encrypted URL and event subscriptions.

entities.name: integration_deliveries
entities.description: Webhook event outbox records with delivery state, retry scheduling and response details.

entities.name: integration_secrets
entities.description: Encrypted platform integration credentials, keyed by integration name and last editor.

entities.name: comments
entities.description: User comments on a research run, optionally attached to one run artifact; deletion preserves the row.

entities.name: notifications
entities.description: In-app notices for a recipient and project, optionally linked to a run and actor.

entities.name: notification_preferences
entities.description: Per-user, per-project notification, digest and quiet-hour preferences; absent rows use defaults.

entities.name: notification_emails
entities.description: Email notice outbox for a recipient and project, with optional run and actor, delivery state and retries.

entities.name: data_connections
entities.description: Saved external project data sources with connector type, non-secret configuration and encrypted credentials.

entities.name: datasets
entities.description: Named project datasets with description, creator and timestamps; each dataset has immutable versions.

entities.name: dataset_versions
entities.description: Immutable dataset snapshots with version number, storage key, SHA-256, row count, columns and source details.

entities.name: research_contexts
entities.description: Archived versioned research context retained for historical runs; no current write API is exposed.

entities.name: research_runs
entities.description: Research runs with versioned research_case JSON, optional dataset/context, pipeline, mode, status, obligations and token budget.

entities.name: stage_runs
entities.description: Engine stage executions with input/config snapshots, progress, usage, prior-stage and origin-decision lineage.

entities.name: stage_decisions
entities.description: Gate and stage decisions with action, payload, user/system/PI actor, optional deciding user and reason.

entities.name: run_events
entities.description: Ordered immutable run events, optionally attributed to a stage, with source sequence, class and payload.

entities.name: run_gates
entities.description: Run review gates, optionally stage-linked, with specification, answer and optional researcher attribution.

entities.name: run_artifacts
entities.description: Immutable run output files with optional stage, schema/version, review metadata, storage key and SHA-256.

entities.name: frame_reviews
entities.description: Stored research-frame review requests and submitted decisions retained for the review API.

entities.name: pi_consultations
entities.description: AI PI consultations for a run and optional stage, with authority, status, redacted request, result and applied decision.

entities.name: pi_notes
entities.description: Research-run lab notebook entries, optionally linked to a PI consultation, with kind, text and actor.

entities.name: cost_entries
entities.description: Idempotent token-usage increments per project and run; source type and source ID identify a stage or PI consultation.

entities.name: cost_ledger_start
entities.description: Ledger starting timestamp; usage before this point is not included in monthly accounting.

entities.name: spending_alerts
entities.description: Already-issued project budget warnings, deduplicated by project, month and alert kind.

entities.name: model_profiles
entities.description: Global stage/review model configuration with provider, base URL, encrypted key and last editor.

entities.name: platform_settings
entities.description: Single record of admin-managed Platform behavior settings, stored as JSON with last editor.

entities.name: engine_settings
entities.description: Admin overrides keyed by engine name, with settings JSON and optional last editor.

entities.name: audit_events
entities.description: Change audit trail with optional user actor, action, resource reference, project context and details.

entities.name: monitoring_events
entities.description: Redacted service telemetry with worker/request/trace context; context identifiers are not entity foreign keys.

entities.name: monitoring_alerts
entities.description: Service monitoring alerts with severity, resolution state and optional acknowledging user.

entities.name: monitoring_capture_gaps
entities.description: Intervals of monitoring capture loss with service, worker context and reason; no entity foreign key.

entities.name: monitoring_worker_states
entities.description: Monitoring worker heartbeat, status, persisted watermark and dropped-event count.

email_otps.user_id.reason: Only sign_in is allowed, so UNIQUE(user_id, purpose) permits at most one row per user.

platform_settings.updated_by_user_id.reason: The single allowed primary-key value permits at most one settings record globally.
